programme.desc: Along the banks of the Mighty Zambezi River, lies The Lower Zambezi National Park. A poignant tale emerges, as ecologist David Ngwenyama goes on a mission to preserve this wild haven from the biggest threat in its history.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: A riveting episode of how Lower Zambezi, came into being, and a relentless quest to protect this unique and fragile ecosystem.

programme.title: Africa Laughs
programme.desc: Africa's funniest stand-up comedians are featured onstage and on location in this laugh-a-minute series. See Eno Inwek represent Nigerian humor like never before!

programme.title: Africa Laughs
programme.desc: Africa's funniest stand-up comedians are featured onstage and on location in this laugh-a-minute series. Check out a day in the life of Kenya funny man Edwin Okong'o.

programme.title: Married to a Baller
programme.desc: In this captivating urban faith stage play, a woman is married to a pro football player who is suddenly injured. Broken in both body and spirit, he hits rock bottom, but his nurse tries to bring him back to the man he was.

programme.title: Kevin Hart: Standing Tall
programme.desc: Laughter is the best medicine. Just ask Kevin Hart. Comedy would rule as antidote to a troubled childhood. Hart's work ethic has no limits with 8 comedy specials, 54 films, 90 TV shows and a global media company.

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 9
programme.desc: On this episode of Pastor wants A wife, things get heated when both pastors confront their ladies about gossip and other things. According to Mpho, pastor Aaron still beats around the bush.

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 10
programme.desc: At this stage of the season, things get more interesting as the two pastors get a chance to visit the ladies' families. Pastor Lincoln visits Anelisa's family and pastor Aaron visits Kelebogile's family

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's first class breakfast from April 11, 1912, featuring over a dozen dishes by Escoffier. He recreates baked apples, smoked salmon coronets, shirred eggs, and buckwheat cakes with blackcurrant conserve. The episode highlights dining venues, passenger pets, and the tragic story of honeymooners Victor and Maria Josefa Peñasco.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - First Class Breakfast on the RMS Titanic

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the 4-6 month, 2,200-mile Oregon Trail journey (1846-1869), covering provisions like flour, bacon, and hardtack, cooking over buffalo chips, and staple meals like Johnny cakes. He discusses hunting, trading with Native Americans, celebrations, and hardships, including spoiled food, salt-rising bread, pies, and pioneers leaving possessions at Fort Laramie.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Pioneers ate on the Oregon Trail

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Ötzi the Iceman's last meal (c. 3,359-3,105BC), discovered in 1991. He covers Ötzi's clothing, tools, health (tattoos, heart disease, parasites), and likely murder by arrow. Using stomach contents-smoked ibex, charred red deer, and einkorn pancake with fiddle ferns-Max cooks over an open fire to mimic Neolithic methods.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Recreating the Last Meal of Ötzi the Iceman

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max traces airline food from 1919's first commercial meal to aviation's Golden Age (1950s-70s). He covers flight kitchens, cold-to-hot meal evolution, themed flights, flight attendant hiring, the 1958 Great Sandwich War, and 1978 deregulation. Max recreates a 1954 United Airlines meal of pot roast, vegetables, Delmonico potatoes, and marshmallow-apple salad.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Airline Food During the Golden Age of Air Travel

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Medieval Irish corned beef and cabbage from *The Vision of Mac Con Glinne* (c. 1100) with onion-leek pottage. He explores Ireland's rigid food hierarchy-peasants ate grains and salted meat, butter signified wealth, monks preferred game, nobles had fresh meat-and cultural practices like fosterage, the 7-year child-rearing system, and a satirical poem about King Cathal's gluttony.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Medieval Irish Food: Peasant to King

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores lighthouse keeper life via an 1881 provisioning list and period recipes. He covers the isolated, demanding job-cleaning Fresnel lenses with mercury, trimming wicks, and cooking with limited supplies like flour, beans, and salt pork. Featuring keepers Henry Long, Mary Ryan, and Hannah Thomas, he recreates Fannie Farmer's 1896 Boston corn chowder with pilot bread.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Eating like a Lighthouse Keeper from the 1800's

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann teaches her Scuola Culinaria student, Karen the traditional Italian culinary secrets of creating soft-as-a-cloud, pillowy gnocchi every time. When they're as perfect as these Amalfi-style gnocchi, all that's needed is a buttery, heavy cream sauce of asparagus tips and lemon zest to make you close your eyes, take one taste and swear you're in Amalfi.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Got Lemons, Make Gnocchi

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: In a matter of minutes, Mary Ann combines sliced chicken breasts with onions, garlic, and turmeric and into the oven it goes to create her husband's recipe Guy's Chicken with Olives and Turmeric. Then she makes another favorite, Meatballs Milan Style. Stuffed with filled with mortadella, beef, and ham and fried to a crunchy crisp, you'll want seconds, thirds, fourths!
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Gaetano's Easy Chicken Casserole

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann and eager Scuola Culinaria student John roll up their sleeves and dive into the essential steps need to create an all-time favorite of favorites, Pizza Margherita. Step by step, sauce by sauce, cheese by cheese learn how to take your pizza all the way from yeast to "Yay!" And they're not done yet, not until they make Fried Dough with Cinnamon and Sugar from yeast to "Yum!"
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Make Pizza with a Friend

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann teams up with Executive Chef David Crinieri to wow her cooking students by exploring the world of perfect pestos. Chef David leads off with a delicate Watercress Pesto tossed with Fresh Spinach Linguine and topped with an Artichoke Crudo. Mary Ann's up next with her signature Broccolini and Artichoke Pesto tossed with Fusilli. Want perfect pesto every time? Try either one-or both!

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia heads to South Carolina to meet the many talented artisans that define Lowcountry. From a basket weaver who is keeping the sweetgrass tradition of the Gullah Geechee people alive, to an intercoastal inspired shrimp recipe served in ironware crafted right down the street. Find out why the Lowcountry is defined by its character as much as it is a spot on the map.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Heritage of the Lowcountry

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to a festival in the Ozarks where she is teaching a cooking class. We follow her as she prepares and gathers her ingredients - we meet a small town chicken farmer, gather produce at the local farmers market, and set the table at a local textile studio where Georgia learns to dye napkins.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Discover Your Roots

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Join Georgia on an urban foraging expedition and learn from an edible and medicinal plants expert as he and Georgia collect a variety of items during a walk through the neighborhood. From flower studded ice cubes, to honeysuckle tea, to dandelion green salad, Georgia is making the most of what is around her.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Into the Wild

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Women from around the country convene in west Texas for a transformative experience in the wild. During the episode, Georgia teaches viewers about the different cuts of venison and the ways to cook them, as well as how to save money by grinding your own meat. The guests and viewers will leave feeling empowered and with a different perspective on what it is to be a human and an omnivore.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Go West, Young Woman

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia hosts a dinner party at her home in Austin, Texas, focusing on ingredients that are as locally sourced and homemade as possible. Pulling produce from her own garden, she turns it into pickled vegetables, tomato bread salad, a lemon balm cocktail and more! Georgia even decorates the dinner table entirely with items she has found in nature.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Entertaining at Home

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - France: The Noble Olive

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the "7-generation framework" - their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Lakota Nation: A Story of Empowerment

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia visits the Catskills in New York, where a couple has created a stunning homestead and serves their community through weekly dinners that now attract people from afar. She heads out into the woods, into the root cellar, and into the kitchen with Jake and Elizabeth as they create a beautiful meal for dinner guests. The couple shares how they created this space and offer inspiring ideas for living and entertaining.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Bovina Farm and Fermentory Story

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia brings the audience into the kitchen with her to share delicious garden to table recipes. Along the way she pays a visit to an artisan beeswax candle maker who teaches her the art of candle making. Georgia then goes to sit at the pottery wheel with a gifted ceramicist to create candle holders and elements for a table setting.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - From Earth to Art

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane visits a famous local marble sculptor en route to visit an old friend and great cook, where she learns the secrets of pinched sweet cheese cakes, ancient sesame-honey confections and more. Back in her own kitchen, she creates a luscious Tinos-style artichoke bread pudding and red mullet in caper sauce, both Tinos traditional specialties.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tinos: Ancient Marble, Timeless Flavors

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: On Mykonos, Diane discovers the quiet life and food of its local farmers, in contrast to the reputation as a dazzling party island. She tastes onion pie, delicious cured pork, and one of the oldest cheeses in the world, kopanisti, still made on the island. In the kitchen, she makes a garlicky local pasta recipe, and a traditional Greek island fish soup.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Food Secrets Of Mykonos

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Gorgeous cafes, bustling nightlife, yachting and water sports, just 20 minutes south of the Greek capital, Athens. Diane visits a fish market where the catch is right off the boat, sails the coast, and returns to her kitchen to create three delicious, contemporary Greek recipes, inspired by the cosmopolitan bustle and fun-loving spirit of the Athenian coast.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Athenian Riviera

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane and friend and ultramarathoner, Dean Karnazes, meet up for a run. He helps Diane hone her technique, sharing healthy eating tips. Together they make a simple Greek salad with local ingredients and enjoy perfect Mediterranean living. Back in her kitchen, Diane cooks up a very healthy plant-forward Messinian meal, with lots of olive oil, beans and greens.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Navarino Challenge

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores everything from beguiling mastiha, to the local pasta to unique tomatoes, dangling like giant rubies against the renowned geometric patterns on medieval houses of Pyrgi. The flavors of historic Chios inspire her to cook up a succulent chicken and quince dish and an easy traditional black eyed pea salad with Mastiha vinaigrette.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tasty Teardrops And Tomatoes: Chios

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Naxos is famed for the quality of its meats, its array of cow's milk and sheep-and-goats' milk cheeses and for its potatoes. Diane heads from the shore straight to a remote mountain hideaway with Alexis in tow, where two local cooks await them with a feast of stuffed lamb, potatoes, and a unique skillet pumpkin-onion pie.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Naxos: Meat & Potatoes Like You Never Had'em

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Near the historic Bay of Navarino, blanketed by olive, citrus trees and home to historical culinary artifacts unearthed in prehistoric clay tablets at Pylos, Diane cooks with two village ladies, making a local pork and fig dish, and olive-oil fried bread. Inspired by the cornucopia of olive oil, oranges and other local delicacies, she cooks up a Messinian meal.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - A Meal In Messinia

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: The second-largest Greek island and an hour from Athens, Diane heads out in search of mushrooms with a local mushroom forager and cultivator. They cook a favorite local recipe "kritharoto," mushrooms with orzo. Diane makes three delectable dishes with mushrooms, wine and local ingrediants, inspired by the flavors of this nearby "secret" land.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Evia - An Island Hiding In Plain Sight

programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to Long Meadow Cider company to see how father and son team make their incredible cider.

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Coffee expert Joey Chase goes on a pilgrimage along an ancient Ethiopian trading route that starts with the modern latte art cafes in Addis Ababa, then through the coffee kingdom of Jimma to the 10,000+-year-old wild coffee Yayu Forest. Village elders share the age-old secrets of hand processing, fire-pit roasting, and brewing of beans followed by a traditional feast.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: After sharing a first-ever taste of coffee in a remote Maasai village, followed by an exploration of the terrain with some new-found friends, Joey explores a grandiose coffee estate in Mt. Kenya. He then jousts with coffee buyers in Nairbobi's auction house and experiences the hand sorting and elaborate tasting of over 100 distinctive coffees in a British Tudor-style plantation cottage.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Touting the practicality of gondola travel, Joey explores the canals of Venice and discovers the oldest coffee shop in Europe. The trail to classic Italian espresso leads from Illy Coffee near the high-fashion metropolis of Trieste to the medieval town of Scarperia where espresso machines are manufactured. Florence boasts a famous barista who prepares a masterful farewell espresso.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Joey hits the streets of Bogota to check out the controversial trade in emeralds, the famous Juan Valdez Cafe, and some classic Colombian cuisine at an elevation of 10,000 feet. A flight to Armenia and subsequent Willy's Jeep trek uncover a remote and hidden world of quaint coffee towns and boutique farms where Joey hosts a group of international coffee buyers.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Joey is welcomed to Sao Paulo with a freshly brewed cup of excellence at The Coffee Lab in the trendy Madalena district. Joey checks out big coffee exporting in the Port of Santos with shipping containers stacked like legos, Jaco bird coffee (foraged from bird poop), and the world's largest savannah grassland, where Daterra Coffee Farms researches small-lot coffees on a massive scale.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa visits a local sugar shack to learn how maple syrup is made during the early spring maple syrup season in Maine. Back at home, she bakes a maple walnut cake, then treats her chickens to some winter treats and shares an easy DIY project for the chicken coop.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Maine Maple Sunday

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa visits a local farm for some expert tips for growing strawberries in Maine, then she shares her secret family strawberry shortcake recipe. She's also growing basil this summer, so she adds some fresh basil and strawberries to her homemade lemonade.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Strawberry Fields Forever

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: It's spring in Maine, so Lisa is planting seeds and getting ready for baby chicks. After making a fun DIY project for her chickens who lay eggs, she shares her best tips and attempts to get one of her hens to raise some baby chicks, then shares a recipe for Scotch Eggs.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - The Chicks are Coming!

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Meet some of Lisa's poultry pals, including a curious Indian runner duck named Fern and one of her French Marans hens who lays gorgeous chocolate brown eggs. Then she shares some of her best tips for raising a mixed flock of chickens, ducks and geese.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Poultry Pals

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa makes a visit to a lavender farm in Maine to learn all about growing and using the aromatic herb in baking and to make a natural chicken coop spray. Back at home, she bakes lavender cupcakes, makes some ice cream, then makes a chicken-themed cornhole game for the backyard.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Lavender in Bloom

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa makes a small basket using wood scraps and wire. Then she takes a trip to a local orchard and bakes an apple pie with some of the apples she's picked. She demonstrates how to make homemade apple cider vinegar, introduces several of her chickens, then makes them some apple treats.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Apple of my Eye

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa shares some basic cooking tips for scrambling, frying and poaching eggs, as well as her secret for perfectly peeled hard-boiled eggs, and then makes a few of her favorite egg recipes including omelets, Eggs Benedict and her unique twist on deviled eggs. She also explains proper egg storage and why some eggs don't need to be refrigerated.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Scrambled It is

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara's in Barcelona to sip gin and tonics in the shadow of the iconic Sagreda Familia, then joins a food writer to make classic Iberico Pork with Romanesco sauce and Gambas Ajillo. At home, Sara whips up Fideo - Barcelona's take on Paella made with noodles instead of rice.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Barcelona: Gaudi, Gin And Gambas

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: In Naples, Sara unlocks the secret recipe for the best Neapolitan pizza at the famous Gino Sorbillos. Fried meat filled pizza may be even better than that, or is the best one a unique star shaped pizza? Just across the bay in Sorrento it's all lemons, all the time as Sara visits a proud family of lemon growers. They make a citrus flecked cheese and Grandma's Lemon Pasta.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Pizza and Lemons: Naples to Sorrento

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Parma, Italy is home to Parmesan cheese, Prosciutto di Parma and some of the best tomatoes in Italy. All three go into a dish Sara cooks with a local chef. You won't find a quicker weeknight meal than his fancy sounding Tagliatelle con Crema di Parmigiana Passata. Sara's Parsley and Asparagus salad makes it a meal. Later, Sara cooks with Italian American chef Joey Campanaro.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Bounty of Parma

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: How do you make any dish even more delicious? Just add cheese! To prove the point Sara's got two recipes: a French Onion Soup Burger topped with melty, gooey cheese and an equally gooey Alsatian Onion Pie with caramelized onions and melted Gruyere that puts it over the top. Later, we visit a dairy farm and then on 'Ask Sara', an easy homemade ricotta.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara's strategy for easy weeknight cooking? Simply cook a dish one night, then repurpose it into a different meal for another night. Maya Kaimal joins Sara to make Turkey Keema with sweet potatoes and ground meat. On another night, that morphs into Indian stuffed peppers. Then Sara Sautee's Duck Breasts for a quick meal. She uses those same Duck Breasts in a mouthwatering Peking Duck Wrap.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Weeknight Two for One

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Holidays and special occasions call for showstopping main courses that take a little extra time. Vegetarians, this one's for you - Sara's elegant Butternut Squash and Date Crostata. Then it's Sara's crispy Roast Duck with Duck Fat Popovers. Also a feature on a woman who is saving the recipes of Italian grandmothers she calls 'Pasta Grannies'.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Cooking fish can be tricky but not with these easy, foolproof fish recipes. First, Sara is joined by food journalist and influencer Anna Gass to make Pesce all'Acqua Pazza. Then Sara goes to Key West to cook with chef Norman Van Aken. He makes a local Bahamian Soup with fresh caught snapper and a "Cut Up" Salad, a potluck of fruit, plucked from the dinner guests trees.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: In Spain, paella is so popular there are competitions between towns for the best recipe. It is especially so in Valencia, where Sara cooks with local chef Franck Garanger. If we didn't have you at Paella, just wait for the dinner where it's eaten right out of the pan with special rules for pilfering your dinner partners portion. Then, Sara sautés fish topped with a colorful Gazpacho Vinaigrette.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Sketches of Spain

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: A food tour of Tunisia's Sidi Bou Said with local chef Malek Labidi ends cooking Shakshuka in a beautiful garden overlooking the sea. Later we dive into the Medina in Tunis to watch women hand make couscous. In Istanbul, a shopping trip with local TV chef Refika Burgul, ends in the kitchen making Salt Cured Sea Bass plus the addictive Turkish beef and French fry favorite, Kochertme.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - A Taste Of Tunisia And Turkey

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati travels to Milpa Alta to harvest and char nopales with Chef Jorge Córcega, then joins Luis Alvarado's family for their storied mole. Over a shared meal, they celebrate how tradition and flavor nourish the community.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Rural Heart

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Sense of Beauty

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11
programme.desc: Introducing the themes of increasing American power; indigenous political aspirations; conflicting interests and goals; growing mutual antagonism; setting the stage for World War I.

programme.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11
programme.desc: An examination of wartime and postwar American policy; showing how Wilson's commitment to an ethnocentrically defined view of national self-determination drives his efforts to shape the postwar settlement in the Middle East.
programme.sub-title: Wilson & the Breakup of the Ottoman Empire

programme.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11
programme.desc: American interest in the Middle East between the wars; revealing one's focus shifting in the 1930s to American interest in Saudi Arabian oil; the increasing activism of American Zionism in response to Hitler's persecution of German Jews.

programme.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11
programme.desc: United States' entry into World War II alters Americans' conception of the Middle East; the Middle East's geopolitical orientation is now seen as vital to American security.

programme.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World
programme.desc: The nature of creation stories.
programme.sub-title: Creation Stories and Why They Matter

programme.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Metaphor and symbol are integral to creation stories, as they form a crucial part of the language of myth.

programme.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Enuma Elish, also called the Seven Tablets of Creation, is a masterpiece of Mesopotamian literature.

programme.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World

programme.sub-title: The Mesopotamian Flood: The Atrahasis Epic

programme.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History
programme.desc: The geographical region known as Greater Middle East; the range of nations and cultures that define it; historical turning points to witness, encompassing conquests, political alliances and Islam's rise; social, intellectual and economic reforms.

programme.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History
programme.desc: Islam's rise is a major turning point; tracing key phases in the life of Muhammad (PBUH); the founding of the faith through his years of opposition; his establishment of Islam as a religious and political entity; the global impact of these events.
programme.sub-title: Muhammad and the Dawn of Islam - 622

programme.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History
programme.desc: The seventh-century Arab invasion of North Africa brings profound change to the entire region; the Arab armies of the newly created Islamic empire try to conquer the territories of Egypt and others; the lasting Arabization and Islamization.

programme.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History
programme.desc: The establishment of the Umayyad Caliphate's capital in Damascus is a key event in early Muslim history; the Umayyads' achievements; locating the empire's capital away from the Arabian Peninsula; the shift from an Islamic empire to imperial power.

programme.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World
programme.desc: During the Third Crusade, the European soldiers spend the winter playing the ancient game of Tables, which would evolve into backgammon by the 20th century.
programme.sub-title: Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon

programme.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Unearthed artifacts from King Tutankhamun's tomb include Senet boards. Historians study the hieroglyphs and investigate the abrupt disappearance of this ancient Egyptian game.
programme.sub-title: Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife

programme.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Developed during the Guptas' rule in India, Chaturanga is a strategy game resembling chess. It gradually wended its way westward to become what it is in the present.
programme.sub-title: Chess: The Evolution of a Strategy Icon

programme.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World
programme.desc: The East Asian games of Xiangqi and Shogi are potentially connected to Chaturanga and chess, but a lack of documentation makes it difficult to ascertain anything.
programme.sub-title: Chess's Eastern Cousins: Shogi and Xiangqi

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.desc: The traditional pilgrimage to Uppsalla to thank the gods brings a torrent of emotions for Ragnar, Lagertha and Athelstan. Travis Fimmel stars.

programme.title: Vikings

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: In the season 2 premiere, the battle begins between Ragnar and King Horik's forces against Jarl Borg in a battle which pits brother against brother.

programme.title: Vikings

programme.title: Vikings

programme.title: Vikings

programme.title: Vikings

programme.title: Vikings

programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un joven esquizofrénico golpea a su hermana y escapa de su casa. La joven descubre que su hermano tiene esquizofrenia y ella podría estar enferma también, ya que su padre le confiesa que su madre era esquizofrénica y que él también lo es.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un joven está enamorado de una muy linda chica. El joven hace de todo para que la chica le haga caso, pero ella solo lo rechaza. El joven abusa de la chica y le destruye la vida.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Humberto es agredido por uno de sus compañeros del salón, harto de la situación decide vengarse de ellos y toma la pistola de su padre para amenazar al niño que lo molesta. Uno de sus amigos le dice que no lo haga y esconde la pistola.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Un joven le roba la cartera a un hombre que vende drogas, el hombre lo encuentra y amenaza a su novia para que el chico le devuelva el dinero; el joven le cuenta la verdad a su tío y atrapan a los vendedores de drogas.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Una joven trabaja duramente para poder pagar su carrera. Un joven busca conquistar a la dulce chica, pero ella no se muestra nada interesada.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Maru sufre de depresión, además abusa de los ansiolíticos y esto provoca descuido y abandono en Nicky, su hija adolescente; Nicky consume inhalables y recae gravemente; su prima trata de ayudarla. Maru reconoce que ella y su hija necesitan ayuda.
programme.sub-title: Aunque la mona se vista de seda

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Jorge es un joven rebelde que no respeta a su madre. Un día se mete en problemas por culpa de su novia. Pero la vida le da una gran lección al perder a su abuela, la única persona que siempre lo apoyó incluso para que él naciera.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Don Tomás sufre un infarto y despierta en un hospital, el señor que lo llevó le dice que es su hijo y le reclama por abandonarlo a él y a su madre. Pero pronto, Isabel descubre que todo es mentira.

programme.desc: Marcelino le pide perdón a Roberta por creer que lo traicionó. Por su parte, Mía no acepta las disculpas de Celina. Mientras tanto, Giovanni acusa a Pilar de emborrachar a Diego para sacarle información.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta amenaza a Pilar con delatarla. Por su parte, León se entera del casete de Diego y lo golpea, pero Tomás se echa a sí mismo la culpa. Celina le advierte a Mía que no tenga relaciones con Joaquín porque anda con Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le regala un traje a Celina para el grupo de baile. Por su parte, León enviará a Diego a un colegio Militarizado. Sin verlo venir, Joaquín se entera de que Alma es mamá de Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma aconseja a Mía esperar para tener relaciones sexuales. Por su parte, Roberta le dice a Alma que rompió con Joaquín y que está embarazada.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Joaquín busca a Roberta para que regresen. Mía se entera de que Miguel le inventó a Joaquín que su papá es narco. Finalmente, Roberta no acepta tener relaciones con Joaquín.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le dice a Joaquín la verdad sobre Franco. Además, León amenaza a Mabel con dejarla en la calle y quitarle a Diego. Por su parte, Roberta se enoja con Enrique por querer andar con Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta golpea a Vico por inventar que anda con Teo. Por su parte, Joaquín le cuenta a Roberta sobre la muerte del hermano de Teo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mabel le pide a Diego quedarse con su papá, porque no quiere que lo lastime. Por su parte, Roberta le aclara a Teo que él no es culpable de la muerte de su hermano. Diego le dice a Roberta que Joaquín la engaña con Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Teo quiere saber si es verdad que su hermano estaba drogado cuando se accidentó, pero sus padres lo niegan; Roberta le dice a Mía que Joaquín anda con las dos y, al vengarse de él, le provoca un accidente; todos creen que Nico es dueño de un café.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma logra que Roberta le cuente sobre su decepción amorosa con Joaquín; Franco encuentra a Mía cantando en un café y la castiga; Celina le dice a Mía que Vico salió con Miguel y que tuvieron relaciones; Joaquín llega en muletas al colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico se enoja con Celina por decir que Miguel pasó la noche en su casa; Mía descubre que Vico es novia de Miguel; Mabel le dice a Diego que lo sacará del colegio; la mamá de Nico se enoja al saber que le gusta Lupita y que no es judía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Roberta hacen creer a todos que Joaquín es homosexual; Celina golpea a Vico por Miguel; Nico termina con Lupita porque quiere a otra; Franco cree que Mía está enferma; Miguel y Diego descubren que los quieren contratar para cantar en el café.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma le dice a Franco que Mía le importa; el señor Mendiola amenaza a Pascual con despedirlo si no pone orden en el colegio; Miguel le dice a Franco que Mía puede atentar contra su salud; Tomás se preocupa porque Diego quiere secuestrarse a sí mismo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Advertido por Madariaga, León arruina los planes de Diego y detiene a uno de sus escoltas por intentar ayudarlo con el autosecuestro. Roberta se opone a que Mía forme parte de la banda. Diego confronta a Tomás por haberlo delatado.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía sufre un ataque al ver una foto de Colucci con Alma en el periódico. Roberta invita a Celina a cantar en la banda. Roberta y Lupita piensan que Jose roba comida para venderla. León le dice a Diego que su mamá decidió no divorciarse.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina cuestiona a Miguel por fijarse en Vico que es su amiga. Por su parte, Roberta invita a Celina a cantar en el grupo musical. Además, Roberta y Lupita piensan que José roba comida para venderla.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta es expulsada del colegio por haberse ido de pinta. Por su parte, el papá de Mía le regala una invitación para que asista al desfile. La logia ataca a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego compara a Esteban con su papá por besar a la esposa del director; Miguel golpea a Giovanni al enterarse de que sale con Celina por hacer un favor y le tiene lástima; Diego discute con Roberta y quiere que uno de los dos se vaya del grupo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel les pide a Roberta y Diego que se queden en el grupo; Mia se enoja al enterarse que tendrá que ir con Miguel al desfile; Alma lleva a Marcelino y Dulce para que los vean Roberta y Lupita; la mamá de Lupita se enoja y quiere llevarse a Dulce.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta necesita escapar de Alma para cantar en el café. Por su parte, Pascual acepta crear una fundación, pero el negocio verdadero es lavar dinero.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita lleva a Alma al café donde canta Roberta. Celina se reconcilia con Mía. La mamá de Miguel se enoja al descubrir que estudia en la Elite Way School. Vico termina con Miguel por temor a la logia. Franco y la mamá de Miguel se conocen.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco invita a Miguel y su mamá a pasar la navidad en su casa. Mientras tanto, Mía y sus compañeros organizan un viaje de fin de año. Alma choca con Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta inventa que Diego y ella son novios. Por su lado, Miguel decide no regresar a Monterrey y se pelea con su mamá, le advierte que vengará la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco le manda decir a Alma que no lo intimidará. Por su parte, la mamá y hermana de Miguel se quedarán con él, en el D.F. Mientras tanto, Mía descubre una foto de Vico desnuda.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El papá de Nico está enfermo en el hospital. Por su parte, Diego le dice a Roberta que la canción la escribió pensando en ella.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pascual quiere que Roberta le pida una disculpa a Hilda, pero Alma desenmascara a la maestra. Por su parte, Roberta invita a Teo a pasar la navidad en su casa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía no quiere entregarle a Miguel el cheque que su papá le mando. Además, Madariaga sabe que Carlos está casado y sale con Lulú. Por su parte, Roberta se enoja al enterarse de que Mía no quería que supieran lo del papá de Nico.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta le hace creer a Mía que su papá murió en un accidente. Franco se sorprende al ver que su exnovia, Valeria, ahora es abogada de Alma. Joaquín le ofrece trabajo a Tomás entregando pedidos de droga. Roberta y Mía se enfrentan en una pelea.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se molesta al saber que alguien del colegio le está inventando chismes. Luján, Roberta y Lupita descubren que Esteban tiene una doble personalidad. Pilar le confiesa a Pascual que Joaquín es su novio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Celina le confiesa a Mía el gran interés que siente por Augusto. Nico idea un plan para poder escapar del colegio. Yolanda se molesta al saber que Nico sigue enamorado de Lupita. Pilar descubre que Joaquín continúa drogándose.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Joaquín idea un plan para que Pilar pase una noche con él. Mía y sus compañeros del colegio se preparan para su viaje a Cozumel. Yolanda le pide a Nico que formalice su relación con Karen.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Joaquín niega que vende droga y acusa a Tomás de distribuirla. Por su parte, Gandía se molesta con Madariaga por citar a los padres de Tomás. Roberta y Mía no quieren pasar el año nuevo con sus papás.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma y Franco se encuentran en un restaurante y pasan juntos el año nuevo. Por otro lado, José roba unos papeles y Teo se adjudica la culpa. Mientras tanto, Nico acepta la condición de su mamá para poder seguir en el colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Un amigo de Diego le da un CD a Roberta para que se lo entregue. Por su parte, Peter le pregunta a Mía si sabe que su papá anda con Valeria.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Tomás le cuenta a sus amigos que Joaquín lo obliga a vender droga. Mía y Celina descubren que Vico les mintió para que se enojaran.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El director amenaza con expulsar a Tomás por vender droga, y él planea escapar del colegio por temor a sus padres. Madariaga, por su parte, quiere llamar a la policía. En tanto, Vico les pide perdón a Mía y Celina.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Las alumnas del grupo de baile se vengan de Lulú. Mía hace que saquen a Miguel de un centro comercial. Alma planea arruinar el romance de Franco y su exabogada. Madariaga está seguro de que es Joaquín el vendedor de droga y se lo dice a Gandía.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Martina está a punto de dar a luz, pero su llegada al hospital se complica cuando ella se queda atrapada en el elevador. La Nena comienza a tener desmayos y vómitos, por lo que Carlos cree que pueda estar embarazada.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La llegada del bebé de Martina a la casa de los López se torna en una pesadilla cuando nadie puede dormir debido al llanto del pequeño. La Nena encuentra mensajes indiscretos en el celular de Adolfo y cree que le es infiel.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: El hermano perdido y no reconocido de Plácido llega a casa de los López para quedarse. Plutarco olvida el cumpleaños de Gaby y tiene que buscar un buen regalo para compensar su error.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Gaby y Plutarco creen que Justito se va a poner celoso con la llegada del nuevo bebé. Plácido decide apostar en la quiniela del fútbol y descubre que tiene los números ganadores, pero Renata comete un error al poner la apuesta.

programme.desc: El baño de la casa tiene un agujero en el techo y Plutarco y Adolfo son los encargados de repararlo. La Nena consigue un servicio para ver películas y series gratis, y lo oculta del resto de la familia.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Renata quiere celebrar el aniversario de Plutarco y Gaby, pero no tienen dinero para hacerlo. Gaby y Plutarco buscan ideas para su regalo. Con la ayuda de toda la familia, Gaby y Plutarco festejan su aniversario.

programme.desc: La madre de Adolfo llega a buscarlo para que se haga cargo de su millonaria empresa familiar. Después de que el casero les exige a los López el pago de la renta, ellos descubren que la familia de Adolfo es millonaria.

programme.desc: Justito descubre que su familia es descendiente de Antonio López de Santa Anna y todos en el edificio los tachan de traidores a la patria. Gaby y Plutarco quedan encerrados en el baño.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Tulio se vuelve el nuevo administrador y le exige a Plácido que pague la renta. Adolfo y Victoria encuentran un tesoro en el departamento y lo ocultan. Martina y la Nena apuestan para ver si Adolfo oculta algo. Silvia Pinal visita a los López.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: You might not be able to change your past, but you can change what happens next. When life feels stuck or uncertain, remember this: the result belongs to God, but your response is still in your hands. You don't have to control the outcome, just move forward and trust Him with what comes next.

programme.title: From The Vault
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals how impossible seasons can prove God's presence while faith waits.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals how God can use unwanted challenges through His limitless creativity.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Feeling like you don't have enough? God has given you an inheritance, so don't let pressure shrink your perspective or make you forget who you are. The God who brought you this far is more than capable of driving out what's in your way.
programme.sub-title: Don't Forget Where You Come From

programme.title: From the Pulpit
programme.desc: Ben Graves teaches that God calls you to face hardship and contend for a legacy rather than hide.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how viewing disappointment through God's faithfulness revives hope.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Faith isn't a destination. In God Knows You Don't, Pastor Steven shows us that even though we don't know what's next, we can trust that God is guiding our steps.

programme.title: From The Vault
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how to find significance instead of waiting for a significant event.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Ever feel like there are too many voices telling you what to do and who to be? The enemy whispers fear, doubt, and distraction, but God's whisper brings peace, purpose, and direction. When you stop agreeing with the enemy's lies and start trusting the whisper of the One who sent you, you'll find confidence in where - and who - you are.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals that God has prepared you for the assignment designed for this season.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: We live in a world that values things more than thoughts, so when God speaks to us, we don't always value it like we should. In this message, learn some of the ways God speaks, when to ask for it, and how to recognize it when He does.
programme.sub-title: When God Gives A Thought To You

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: In the Good Friday sermon Help Me Fail, Pastor Steven Furtick explores how embracing our failures can lead to spiritual growth and a deeper understanding of God's grace. He encourages us to see failure not as a setback, but as an opportunity to draw closer to God and experience His transformative power.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: In When God Goes In, Pastor Steven Furtick teaches us that when we let God remove what's limiting us, we make room for Him to lift us to our full potential.

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick
programme.desc: Don't judge any one part of your life in isolation or let unmet expectations define your future. God's not finished with your story, and He didn't bring you this far to let you turn back now.
programme.sub-title: The Hardest Part Is Behind You

programme.title: Elevation With Steven Furtick

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: Steve Harvey assumes the hosting duties for this daytime game show in which five members of one family are pitted against five members of another family. Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

Then the bizarre sights and sounds begin, which seem to elude detection by the only other servant or the gloomy institution's director. Is this all in Anna's mind? Or does something more sinister lurk in the heart of St. Ange?

programme.title: Session 9
programme.desc: A tale of terror when a group of asbestos removal workers start work in an abandoned insane asylum. The complex of buildings looms up out of the woods like a dormant beast. Grand, imposing, abandoned, deteriorating. The residents of Danvers, Massachusetts, steer well clear of the place. But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors.

programme.title: SiREN

The night soon takes a twisted turn for the worse when the group is invited to a seedy underground club. After Jonah frees a seemingly imprisoned dancer, he realizes that the woman he released is actually a terrifying, legendary creature that will stop at nothing to claim her prey.

programme.title: The Skulls
programme.desc: For Luke McNamara (Joshua Jackson), an invitation to join the prestigious secret college organization, The Skulls, is a dream come true. But he soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruit Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

programme.title: Stephanie

programme.title: Virus

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: Sexo y crimen
programme.desc: Un médico es extorsionado por el esposo de su amante para que firme una acta de defunción y ella pueda cobrar un seguro.

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Guantanamera
programme.desc: Una mujer viaja a Cuba y encuentra de nuevo a su viejo novio de la infancia, quien está casado con una mujer infiel.

programme.title: El Hechizo del Pantano
programme.desc: Un niño juega en el bosque con una chiquilla y cuando su padre se entera descubren que ella murió años atrás.

programme.title: Desaparecidos
programme.desc: Un hombre y una mujer viajan en el tiempo para comprobar la veracidad de una leyenda que afirma que un pueblo entero desapareció completamente.

programme.title: Debieron ahorcarlos antes
programme.desc: Dos sujetos roban el oro del ejército, Silvestre es aprendido, pero el abuelo huye junto a Joe Oaxaca y el federal Tomás Bueno. Se desata un tiroteo del que tendrán que salir bien librados.

programme.title: Morgana
programme.desc: El suicidio de una mujer demente a finales del siglo XIX tiene consecuencias terribles en la época actual. El miedo y el horror se apoderan especialmente de una jovencita en una pesadilla que parece llevarla directamente a su propia muerte.

programme.title: Los desalmados
programme.desc: Dos cazarrecompensas se convierten en fieles y buenos amigos, a pesar de los problemas debido a sus profesiones.

programme.title: Verdugo de traidores
programme.desc: Un comandante de policía tiene que eliminar la corrupción que existe en su departamento a causa de los sobornos.

programme.title: Garra de Tigre
programme.desc: Un maestro de artes marciales cría a tres niños para que sean hombres de bien y sepan defenderse de "Garra de Tigre".

programme.title: El mil hijos
programme.desc: El dueño de una cadena de taquerías tiene hijos con distintas mujeres quienes a su vez lo engañan con otros hombres. Él ignora la situación y ellas se aprovechan por la conveniencia de sus negocios. Tras una ida al hospital se descubre la verdad.

programme.title: El Payo: un hombre contra el mundo
programme.desc: El Payo protege a su familia del bajo mundo del crimen, el cual quiere robarle su vida y su integridad.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Malverde, la leyenda
programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: Sor Batalla
programme.desc: Una monja es enviada a un pueblo lejano, gobernado por un hombre malvado, y con su fe y alegría intenta cambiarlo.

programme.title: El tesoro del amazonas
programme.desc: Un aventurero y sus amigos compiten contra un ex-nazi y otras personas que buscan un tesoro de diamantes en la selva sudamericana.

programme.title: Los supersabios
programme.desc: Los supersabios construyen un cohete espacial. Panza Y Pola provocan la curiosidad de los villanos Solomillo y el médico. Los muchachos despegan su nave y se encuentran con Panza y Pola para comenzar a explorar.

programme.title: Ha entrado una mujer
programme.desc: Una mujer que no pudo tener consigo a su hijo de pequeño lo encuentra de joven y lucha para ganar su aprecio.
